Longitudinal research

Employment history and later life cognition

At UC Irvine, I helped harmonize a study across multiple waves and contributed statistical analysis examining how employment history related to cognition in later life.

Longitudinal dataData harmonizationStatistical analysisResearch publication

Research contribution

Harmonize measures

I helped align variables across multiple waves so that employment and cognition measures could be studied consistently over time.

Support statistical analysis

I prepared analysis ready data and contributed to the evidence base used in the research.

Publication

Lu, P., Yin, H., and Li, C. (2025). Sex differences in employment history and old age cognition: Evidence from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study. Journal of Women and Aging, 37(4), 268 to 283.

View the published article
This work strengthened my interest in questions where careful measurement matters as much as the model itself.
